book.name: Jeramaiya
book.title: Jeramaiya Jeramaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: Aibin kipgon tok, “Aibin wandim main hed bina jidan jis laik det wel garram loda woda, en main dubala ai bina jidan wulijim det woda weya oldei randanbat, wulijim ai gin kraikraibat ebridei en ebrinait blanga main pipul olabat hubin gitkil.
Ai wandim abum pleis langa det deset kantri blanga jidan deya wulijim ai gin gidawei brom main pipul olabat, dumaji olabat nomo jidan trubalawan, en olabat jidan brabli trikibala.

Olabat oldei redi blanga dalimbat laiya, en olabat laiyinbalawei jidan bos langa dijan kantri.” Lagijat na aibin tok. Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok na, “Main pipul olabat kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting, en olabat nomo sabi mi blanga olabat God.

“Nomo enibodi kaan trastim im fren, en nomo enibodi kaan trastimbat langa im rileishanmob du. Blanga ebribodi rileishanmob brabli trikibala jis laik Jeikob, en ebriwan tok nogudbalawei blanga im frenmob.

Yumob dalimbat laiya langa yumob fren, en nobodi nomo tok trubala wed, dumaji yumob mawus oldei dalimbat laiya, en yumob kaan neba stap dumbat det nogudbala ting. Yumob oldei ardimbat pipul olataim, en yumob oldei dum trikibala ting olataim du. Yumob oldei gibitbat mi bekboun.

“Wal ai garra meigim main pipul olabat jidan klinbala jis laik det gol weya dei meigim klinbala brom ola rabish. Ai garra testimbat olabat laif. Dumaji main pipul olabat oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, wal wanim najawan ting ai garra dum langa olabat?
“Blanga yumob mawus, im jis laik shapwan spiya, en yumob oldei dalimbat laiya. Ebribodi toktokbat gudbala wed langa im fren, bat imbin oni trai en trepam im fren.
“Wanim ai garra du? Ai garra panishim yumob blanga detlot ting na? Wanim ai garra du? Gibit mi wan gudwan risan wulijim ai kaan panishim langa yumob.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

Wal aibin tok na, “Ai garra fil sori blanga detlot bigwan hil, en ai garra krai blanga det grinwan gras dumaji olabat bin draiyap, en nomo enibodi go deya na, najing. Ai nomo irrim detlot buligi jinginatbat deya, en ol detlot bard en wailwan enimul bin ol gowei.”

Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ai garra meigim Jerusalem jidan rabishwan. Ola wailwan dog gulum jekal garra oldei jidanbat deya, en detlot taun blanga Juda garra jidan jis laik det deset kantri, weya nobodi jidan.”

Wal aibin tok, “YAWEI, wotfo dijan kantri bin binijap en im jidan draiwan jis laik deset kantri wulijim nobodi gin trebul thru iya? Hu brabli klebabala blanga sabi dijan? Langa hu yubin dalimbat dijan, wulijim im gin dalimbat najalot pipul?”

Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Wal dijan bin hepin dumaji main pipul olabat nomo bin laigim det gudbalawan wed weya aibin gibitbat langa olabat. En olabat nomo bin duwit en teiknodis langa mi wanim aibin oldei dalimbat langa olabat.
En olabat bin go mowa nogud, en olabat bin stil kipgon weshipbat det drimin sheip gulum Beil, dumaji olabat grengrenfathamob bin oldei titjimbat langa olabat blanga dumbat detkain ting na.

Wal yu garra lisin langa mi na. Mi na YAWEI det brabli haibala boswan God, det God blanga ola Isreil pipul en ai garra dum brabli nogudbala ting langa olabat na. Ai garra gibit main pipul olabat nogudwan plent blanga dagadagat, en poisinwan blanga dringgimbat.

En ai garra spredimat olabat langa ola difrinwan kantri weya olabat en olabat grengrenfathamob neba bin sabi bifo, en ai garra jandim detmatj solja langa olabat raidap ai garra binijimap olabat brabliwei.”
Detlot pipul brom Jerusalem bin jinginat langa najalot kantri blanga albumbat olabat

Wal YAWEI det boswan God bin kipgon tok, “Yumob jinggabat wanim hepinbat na. Yumob jingat langa detlot hu oldei kraikraibat langa fyunral blanga kaman, detlot wuman na hu oldei singsingbat detlot fyunral song.”

Wal detlot pipul bin tok na, “Yu dalim olabat blanga kaman kwikbala na en sing det fyunral song blanga melabat na, raidap melabat dubala ai garra jidan garram detmatj tiyas, en melabat ai du garra jidan brabli wetwan brom kraikraibat.”
Irrim langa olabat kraikraibat langa Jerusalem, “Wi binij na! Wi jidan brabli sheimwan na! Wi garra lafta libum wi kantri, en blanga wi haus bin binijap du.”

Wal aibin tok, “Ol yumob wuman, yumob irrim langa YAWEI. Yumob lafta teiknodis langa im wed. Yumob oldei titjimbat ol yumob dodamob hau blanga jidan soriwei, en yumob kipgon titjimbat ol yumob fren blanga singsingbat det fyunral song.

Wal deth bin kaman snikinwei langa wi haus. Imbin kaman langa wi speshalwan haus. Imbin kilim ded wi bigininimob ebriweya langa detlot strit, en ol detlot yangmen bin dai deya langa detlot pleis weya olabat oldei baiyimbat en selimbat olkainaba ting.

Ola dedwan bodi bin spredat ebriweya, jis laik enimul minyuwa jidan langa fam, en jis laik detlot sid daga wen sambodi bin kadimbat en nobodi bin gajimbat. Wal lagijat na YAWEI bin dalim mi blanga tok.”

Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ola klebabala men kaan tok praudbalawei blanga olabat klebabalawei. En detlot strongbala men kaan tok praudbalawei blanga olabat strongbalawei. En detlot ritjwan men kaan tok praudbalawei blanga olabat mani en ebrijing dei garram.

If enibodi wandim tok praudbalawei, wal im gin tok praudbalawei dumaji im sabi mi en im teiknodis langa mi, dumaji ai laigim olabat detmatj olataim, en ai gibit ebribodi feyago. Wal dislot ting na meigim mi brabli gudbinji.

“Det taim im kaminap na wen ai garra panishimbat ol detlot pipul langa Ijip, Juda, Idam, Eman, en Moweb en detlot deset pipul hu oldei kadimbat en oldei meigimbat olabat heya shotwan. Ol dislot pipul bin sekamsais, bat dei nomo bin kipum det strongwan pramis wibin meigim mijamet. Nomo eni detlot pipul en nomo eni pipul blanga Isreil bin trai blanga kipum det strongwan pramis wibin meigim mijamet.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
